title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Real Madrid's Galáctico Strategy: President Florentino Pérez has teased a massive €150M bid for a non-forward 'superstar' outside the Premier League, with Michael Olise and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia emerging as top rumored targets.

AI Development & Infrastructure: New tools like OnPilot and Hermes Desktop are enhancing productivity, while discussions around DeepSeek v4 highlight the shift toward ultra-low-cost, high-performance inference models.
SpaceX Growth: The company is reportedly preparing for a highly anticipated IPO within a week, signaling a major transition for the aerospace giant into public markets.

Corporate & Market Shifts: Vercel's acquisition of Turborepo-related assets and the ongoing debate over private credit risks within traditional banking highlight significant structural changes in tech and finance.
Sports Evolution: FIFA is introducing a new pre-match ceremony format for the World Cup, replacing traditional lineups with team circles and giant flag displays to modernize the viewer experience.

items.title: @evanyou: Vercel Acquisition & Vue Independence
items.body: Evan You clarifies that while recent acquisitions strengthen the financial support for Vue contributors, Vue remains an independent project and will maintain vendor-neutral relationships within its ecosystem.

items.title: @cjzafir: DeepSeek v4 Cost Efficiency
items.body: Analysis of DeepSeek v4 models shows significant cost-per-token advantages, with 1M input tokens priced at approximately $0.0036, suggesting a new benchmark for budget-friendly, high-instruction-following AI.

items.title: @DamiDefi: SpaceX IPO Analysis
items.body: Analysis of SpaceX's S-1 filing ahead of its upcoming IPO reveals critical financial details buried in the 300-page document, highlighting the company's trajectory as it prepares to go public.

items.title: @PalantirTech: USDA Ontology & Food Security
items.body: Palantir demonstrates how its Ontology system is being used by the USDA to govern disconnected databases, reducing AI hallucinations and securing the national food supply chain through auditable data tech.

items.title: @imbabybrooklyn: Hermes Desktop Multi-Profile Management
items.body: Nous Research's Hermes Desktop now supports simultaneous multi-profile sessions, allowing users to switch mid-thread and reference different chat contexts with visual color tagging.

items.title: @DeadlineDayLive: Real Madrid's €150M Galáctico Bid
items.body: Real Madrid President Florentino Pérez has confirmed a plan to launch a massive €150M bid for a 'Galáctico' profile player if re-elected, specifically targeting a star outside the Premier League.

items.title: @WSJ: Private Credit & Banking Risks
items.body: A report highlights the growing exposure of traditional banks to private credit firms, with $300 billion in loans now facing scrutiny as market cracks begin to appear in the once-isolated sector.

items.title: @elonmusk: SAVE America Act Vote
items.body: The U.S. Senate has rejected a motion to include the SAVE America Act in the budget reconciliation, with a narrow 48-50 vote highlighting deep partisan divisions on election-related legislation.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich's Transfer Veto
items.body: Bayern Munich's supervisory board reportedly vetoed the signing of Kennet Eichhorn due to high signing fees, demonstrating a shift toward stricter financial oversight despite manager Vincent Kompany's approval.

items.title: @DeclareNews: 2024 Voting Law Complications
items.body: A 2024 law that altered vote-counting methods has created an implementation crisis as officials struggle to establish a replacement process ahead of upcoming deadlines.

items.title: @TouchlineX: FIFA World Cup Ceremony Overhaul
items.body: FIFA has unveiled a new pre-match protocol where players form circles in their own halves rather than parallel lines, accompanied by massive flag displays during national anthems.

items.title: @cosmicbooknews: Campaign to Save Stargate
items.body: Actor Michael Shanks is leading a fan campaign to revive the Stargate franchise after Amazon canceled a new series, urging involvement from original creators and the legacy cast.

items.title: @TouchlineX: England's Heat Struggle in USA
items.body: Reports indicate the England national team is struggling to adapt to the high temperatures in the USA during their current tour, potentially impacting their physical performance and training schedule.

items.title: @WhoScored: Premier League CB Rankings
items.body: Historical data shows Virgil van Dijk has been the highest-rated centre-back in the Premier League for 6 of the last 11 seasons, though Gabriel Magalhães has taken the top spot for the 2025/26 season.
